Onikuma CW917 Wired RGB Ergonomic Gaming Mouse with 3600 DPI

Upgrade your daily gaming setup and navigation fluidity with the highly reliable Onikuma CW917 Wired RGB Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this budget-friendly PC hardware gaming peripheral is masterfully engineered for casual players, rising esports enthusiasts, and digital web managers across Egypt who demand stable USB tracking, immediate click actuation, and zero wireless latency. Backed by an official 1-year warranty for full absolute peace of mind, this mouse features an ergonomic right-handed contour design that supports your palm naturally during extended gaming sessions or professional data management layouts.

The Onikuma CW917 is equipped with an efficient optical tracking sensor supporting a 4-stage adjustable resolution framework scaling up to 3600 DPI maximum limit, ensuring smooth and custom pixel movement across your desktop screen environment. It features a layout of 6 responsive buttons that make gaming execution and web macro shortcuts simple and effortless. To elevate your desktop aesthetics, the mouse is wrapped in vibrant multi-zone RGB light modes that transition beautifully during dark room setups. Finished with a heavy-duty high-speed wired USB interface line, it provides seamless plug-and-play functionality on all modern hardware platforms.
